statement.lead: Aluma was born from a meeting of material and light.
statement.body: We design and build outdoor furniture to order — aluminium frames, Sunbrella fabrics and stone surfaces chosen to stand up to Israeli sun, salt and rain. Every piece is measured for the space it goes into, and stays outside all year.
